description: This Python module provides functions to realign subtitle cues to a transcript, primarily used for subtitle synchronization tasks. It includes utilities for text normalization, timing adjustment, and an algorithm for greedy monotonic alignment based on token similarity, ensuring non-overlapping and well-formatted subtitle timings.

methods.name: str _normalize_text(s: str)
methods.description: Lowercases, strips punctuation (except apostrophes), and squeezes whitespace for text normalization.

methods.name: float _jaccard(a_tokens: List[str], b_tokens: List[str])
methods.description: Computes Jaccard similarity between two lists of tokens.

methods.name: float _safe_float(v, default=0.0)
methods.description: Converts a value to float safely with a default fallback.

methods.name: List[Dict] _sort_by_start(items: List[Dict])
methods.description: Sorts subtitle or transcript segments by their start time, coercing non-dicts into dicts.

methods.name: float _duration(item: Dict)
methods.description: Calculates the duration of a subtitle or transcript segment.

methods.name: str _merge_texts(items: List[Dict])
methods.description: Concatenates texts from a list of subtitle or transcript segments.

methods.name: Tuple[float,float] _span_time(items: List[Dict])
methods.description: Returns start and end times of a list of transcript segments.

methods.name: float _clip(val: float, lo: float, hi: float)
methods.description: Clamps a value within specified bounds.

methods.name: List[Dict] _enforce_monotonic_nonoverlap(subs: List[Dict], min_gap: float = 0.02, min_dur: float = 0.2)
methods.description: Adjusts subtitle timings to ensure monotonic, non-overlapping, and minimal duration constraints.

methods.name: Tuple[int,int,float] _best_transcript_span_for_sub( sub_tokens: List[str], transcript: List[Dict], start_idx: int, max_span: int = 5, min_sim: float = 0.2, )
methods.description: Finds the best contiguous span of transcript segments matching a subtitle based on token similarity.

methods.name: Tuple[float,float] _distribute_time_within_span( sub_text: str, span_text: str, span_start: float, span_end: float )
methods.description: Estimates subtitle start and end times within a transcript span proportionally to text length.

methods.name: List[Dict] align_subtitles_to_transcript( transcript: Union[List[Dict], Dict[str, Any]], subtitles: List[Dict], *, max_span: int = 5, min_similarity: float = 0.2, min_duration: float = 0.4, min_gap: float = 0.02, )
methods.description: Main public function that aligns subtitle cues to a transcript, normalizing data, performing token-based greedy alignment, adjusting timings, and enforcing non-overlap constraints.
